    SELECT sr.matchref, CAST(sr.sprint_performance->>'final_position' AS int) as fp
    FROM sprint_results sr
),
gap_calc AS (
    SELECT w.matchref,
           sp.sprint_performance->'timing'->>'final_time' as gap_str
    FROM s1 w
    JOIN sprint_results sp ON w.matchref = sp.matchref AND CAST(sp.sprint_performance->>'final_position' AS int) = 2
    WHERE w.fp = 1
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT matchref,
           CASE 
               WHEN gap_str LIKE '+%' THEN 
                   CASE 
                       WHEN gap_str LIKE '+%:%' THEN 
                           (SPLIT_PART(gap_str, ':', 1)::int * 60 + SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(gap_str, ':', 2), '.', 1)::int + SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(gap_str, ':', 2), '.', 2)::numeric / 1000)
                       ELSE 
                           gap_str::numeric
                   END
               ELSE 0 
           END as gap_seconds
    FROM gap_calc
)
SELECT r.yr, r.rnum
FROM gaps g
JOIN races r ON g.matchref = r.rak_id
WHERE g.gap_seconds > 5;
